title: Operating Lines of Credit AutoDraft Discount and the Line's Payment Record
content:
The AutoDraft discount granted on an Operating Lines of Credit line on the enrolment day depends on the line's payment record over the twelve whole months before that day.

## Rule

The AutoDraft discount is:

- **0.25 times the product's AutoDraft discount** when one or more late charges were charged on the line in the twelve whole months before the enrolment day;
- **0.5 times the product's AutoDraft discount** when no late charge was and two or more payments on the line came back unpaid in those twelve months;
- **the product's AutoDraft discount** when no late charge was and fewer than two payments came back unpaid.

Late charges are the fee charges with the late charge fee code in the line's transaction history; payments that came back unpaid are the returned interest payments and returned principal payments on the line. The AutoDraft discount so set is one of the rate discounts that are added together and capped at the product's discount cap.

## Discount by product (percentage points)

| Product | Product AutoDraft discount | One or more late charges | No late charge, two or more returned payments | No late charge, fewer than two returned payments |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 0.125 | 0.03125 | 0.0625 | 0.125 |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | 0.125 | 0.03125 | 0.0625 | 0.125 |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | 0.125 | 0.03125 | 0.0625 | 0.125 |
| Revolving Operating Line | 0.125 | 0.03125 | 0.0625 | 0.125 |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Combinations (hypothetical Revolving Operating Line)

| Late charges in the twelve months | Returned payments in the twelve months | AutoDraft discount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 0.03125 |
| 2 | 3 | 0.03125 |
| 0 | 2 | 0.0625 |
| 0 | 1 | 0.125 |
| 0 | 0 | 0.125 |
